menu.prompt.label: menu
menu.cmd.long:
Opens the interactive menu. Scan, plugin, benchmark, OpenAPI, diff, and suppress flows are available, and the command console can run every Gash command.

Language: TR by default. Use '--lang en', GASH_LANG=en, or the in-menu 'l' shortcut to switch to EN.
Keys: every tab has a single-letter shortcut; Enter opens the highlighted tab, ':command' runs a command without leaving the menu, 'cancel' during a prompt goes back, and Ctrl+C stops the running command.
